name: The majority voted in favour of a [motion](https://www.openaustralia.org.au/debate/?id=2025-02-13.45.1) introduced by Watson MP [Tony Burke](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/watson/tony_burke) (Labor), which means it was successful. ### Motion text > *That [standing order 43(a)](https://www.aph.gov.au/-/media/05_About_Parliament/53_HoR/532_PPP/Standing_Orders/Chapter_6.pdf) be suspended until the conclusion of proceedings on the bill.* Standing orders are the usual procedural rules of parliament. ### Standing order 43 > *43 Members’ statements* > > *...* > > *(c) During these periods, when called on by the Chair, a Member, but not a Minister (or Parliamentary Secretary), may make a statement for no longer than 90 seconds.*
